title: Bazaar - a PoC for buiding web3 native communities
description:
Ethereum is becoming the bedrock for building decentralized applications on the Internet. However, community platforms are still hung over on non-native web3 solutions. Bazaar fixes the incongruity of having centralized meeting places for decentralized systems/protocols. Bazaar is a platform that's solving problems for the native blockchain communities:
- Native wallet logins
- Decentralized reputation system spanning across communities
- Trustless with a community approved plugin system for community approved smart contracts
- Native (plugin-less; non web2 ) interactions amongst commumity members
- A native smart contract plugin system for rich and composable community interactions
